cohort: 546 women who underwent urogenital fistula repair at Kitovu Mission Hospital in Masaka, Uganda
finding: Higher parity, shorter labor duration, and history of cesarean or cesarean hysterectomy were associated with ureteric involvement in urogenital fistula.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery and cesarean hysterectomy were more common in women with ureteric involvement compared to those without (73.9% and 13% vs 61.4% and 5.8%).
